verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਲਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਅਮੋਲੁ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: mul na milai amol na keemat paieeaai|

en.bdb: The way of life of gurmukhs is invaluable;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇ ਤਰਾਜੂ ਤੋਲੁ ਨ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੁਲਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: pai taraajoo tol na atul tulaieeaai|

en.bdb: It cannot be purchased; on weighing scale it cannot be weighed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਖਤੁ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਨ ਡੋਲਿ ਡੋਲਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: nij ghar takhat addol na ddol ddolaieeaai|

en.bdb: Stabilizing in one’s own self and not getting frivolous in his way of life.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਨਿਰੋਲੁ ਨ ਰਲੇ ਰਲਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th nirol na rale ralaieeaai|

en.bdb: This way is distinct and does not become defiled even when joined with some one else.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਥਾ ਅਕਥ ਅਬੋਲੁ ਨ ਬੋਲ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: kathaa akath abol na bol bulaieeaai|

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਅਭੋਲੁ ਨ ਭੋਲਿ ਭੁਲਾਈਐ।
verses.translit_en: sadhaa abhul abhol na bhol bhulaieeaai|

en.bdb: This way transcends all ommissions and all anxieties.
Absorbed in equipoise this gurmukh-way of life gives balance to life.
The gurmukh quaffs from  the tank of nectar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਟੋਲੀ ਇਕ ਟੋਲੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਈਐ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: lakh Tolee ik Tol na aap ganaieeaai ||5||

en.bdb: The end result of lacs of experiences is the gurmukh  never exhibits his ego.
